title: Create an identity provider configuration (execute)
description: Step 2 of 2 for create identity provider configuration. Verifies the confirmation_hash from -prepare and the literal "confirm" string typed by the user, then performs the action. ONLY call this after the user has explicitly typed "confirm" in chat. Original action: Create an organization identity provider configuration for SAML, OIDC, SCIM, or XAA (ID-JAG). Set `config_scope` to `saml`, `oidc`, `scim`, or `xaa`. Use `domain_scope: selected` with `organization_domain_ids` to link specific organization domains, or `domain_scope: all` to cover all verified organization domains. SAML uses `saml_entity_id`, `saml_acs_url`, and `saml_x509_cert`; OIDC uses `oidc_issuer_url`, `oidc_client_id`, and `oidc_client_secret`; SCIM can be enabled with `scim_enabled`; XAA uses `id_jag_issuer_url` with optional JWKS and allowed-client settings. The create call requires explicit user confirmation before execution.
